# Avient Advances Sustainability Goals with Renewable Electricity from TotalEnergies Solar Installation


##### November 10, 2026


##


*Aerial view of TotalEnergies' La Carrascosa photovoltaic installation in Andalusia, Spain, which serves as the foundation for the renewable energy initiative.*


*To download a high-resolution image, please click here:*[FOR MEDIA USE ONLY](https://avient.stockpress.co/s/81699e73)


**CLEVELAND and MADRID** – November 10, 2026 – Avient Corporation, an innovator of materials solutions, and TotalEnergies today announced the first-year results of their 15-year power purchase agreement (PPA).


The PPA took effect in September 2025 and will provide Avient with a total of approximately 1.6 TWh of certified renewable energy from the La Carrascosa solar plant in Guillena (Seville). La Carrascosa is a 46.2 MWac photovoltaic project operated by TotalEnergies and inaugurated in 2025. Under this agreement, 100% of its output is dedicated to supplying Avient with renewable electricity.


Since the contract took effect, the partnership has had a significant impact on Avient’s operations. The plant, which forms part of the Guillena solar complex, TotalEnergies’ largest onshore renewable energy facility in Europe, produced approximately 20 GWh of clean energy for Avient between September and December 2025.


“We are delighted to supply Avient with renewable electricity from our La Carrascosa solar farm in Spain. We are currently implementing our integrated strategy across the entire electricity value chain in the country, from generation to storage and supply to end consumers, and these initial results for our customer Avient mark another step forward,” said **José Manuel Gallego, Director of Corporate Sales at TotalEnergies in Spain.**


“Energy from this TotalEnergies facility contributes to Avient’s global renewable electricity objectives and progress towards our 2030 goals, while helping our customers reduce emissions across their value chains,” said **Nello Rizzo, SVP and Chief Supply Chain Officer at Avient.**


**About Avient**

By intersecting our broad portfolio of technologies with the product roadmaps of our customers, we help create differentiated and high-performance products that make the world better and more sustainable. **About TotalEnergies**


TotalEnergies is a global integrated energy company that produces and markets energies: oil and biofuels, natural gas and green gases, renewables and electricity. Our more than 100,000 employees are committed to provide as many people as possible with energy that is more reliable, more affordable and more sustainable. Active in about 120 countries, TotalEnergies places sustainability at the heart of its strategy, its projects and its operations.
